purpose: The reasons band of a marketing page: an optional centered section title over a frame grid of media tiles, each a registry illustration above a short heading and a sentence. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-tiles-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `registration-frame`, `card-grid`, `media-tile` and `illustration`. `variant` picks the layout only: `artwork` is four columns with marks on every corner, `illustrated` is three columns with marks on the bottom rule; the tiles keep the same shape in both.
useWhen: Use FeatureTilesSection for a static set of picture tiles.
To state three or four reasons to buy, each with a picture, under a product or pricing argument.
avoidWhen: For linked use cases or a grid of claims without pictures → use `capability-grid-section`.
For a scroll-driven walkthrough with one screen per feature → use `feature-scroll-section`.
related: `media-tile` — the picture-over-copy cell each tile is rendered with.
`feature-widgets-section` — the sibling band whose cells carry an action each.
bestPractices: Match the tile count to the variant: four tiles for `artwork`, three for `illustrated`.
Give a tile its art as `illustration`, a name of the illustration registry; a tile without one renders without a picture. `scale` sizes the illustration in its frame.
Leave `title` empty to drop the header when the band sits under a hero that already states it; set `anchor` when a link above scrolls to the band.
